answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake behind one identity and earn reputation only through attested work over time. A new identity starts with zero trust, like a raven landing at an empty jetty: it can watch, but it cannot vote or claim rewards until peers attest real contributions. Forging a thousand identities then means splitting stake a thousand ways and waiting through the same slow karst-like grind of earned history, so the cost of a Sybil swarm grows linearly while its influence stays near zero until the stake is actually at risk.
